summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Tradr 2X Long STX Daily ETF (STXX) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund provides 2x exposure, less fees and expenses, to the daily price movement of Seagate Technology Holdings plc (STX). Seagate Technology Holdings plc is a data storage technology company that develops hard disk drives, solid-state drives, and storage infrastructure solutions for enterprise and consumer markets worldwide. STXX was launched on Apr 24, 2026 and is issued by Tradr.

data.title: Tradr Set to Launch Leveraged ETFs on AXTI, CPNG, MPWR and STX
data.text: NEW YORK--(BUSINESS WIRE)---- $AXTI #ETFS--Tradr ETFs announces the launch of 2X long leveraged ETFs on AXTI, CPNG, MPWR and STX.
